random_training_budget.note: Matched budget and initial reset states; no claim of identical action RNG or episode boundaries.

limitations: Fresh diagnostic rollout from a saved policy; no updated weights are saved or used for training.
All minibatch gradients are measured at the same parameter state, not along the four-epoch PPO update path.
Raw gradient norms do not account for Adam scaling; the separate one-minibatch counterfactual includes the saved optimizer state.
This diagnoses local update pressure, not long-run causal effects or scoring performance.

checks: Source snapshots, unchanged PPO implementation, fresh initialization, complete step sequence, actual optimizer counter, checkpoint roundtrips and repeated controls passed.
limitations: One selected training seed; independent training-seed replication is still needed.
Reused 128-game evaluation bank; comparisons are exploratory. Paired p-values are unadjusted scoring-probability tests, not tests of score magnitude.
Rollout length, gamma and lambda change together, with different RNG/update scheduling.
